literal_constraints.interpretation: Conditional prohibition on unsupported claims, not a requirement to file, transfer assets or accredit a real person before documenting the programme.

literal_constraints.interpretation: No taxonomy, tag code, floor or production allowlist change.

literal_constraints.interpretation: Specify each required process, evidence and responsible role in the design; operating any such programme still requires those actual inputs.

judgment.reason_not_complete_now: Current mark-use/self-declaration, interface vector and recusal tools explicitly do not deliver the complete certifier test and accreditation process. No full programme specification/application-review workflow or supported/refused end-to-end evidence is present.
judgment.required_prior_to_implementation: Parent records this technical design acceptance after distinct review; it authorizes preparation/testing only, not live institution/policy/mark/accreditation adoption.

programme_specification: Versioned scope, actual individual publisher, prospective institution/mark holder clearly unselected, accountable preparation/review/appeal roles and authority limits.
Closed claim-scope matrix: selected protocol/interface conformance; per-tag empirical validation; private organization-policy/service scope. No borrowing one scope’s evidence to grant another.

What a certifier must examine: exact implementation/source/configuration, supported/unsupported/failure/privacy/independence cases, source-bound evidence integrity and reproducible procedure. Per-tag independent labels, accepted numeric gates and uncertainty/calibration remain required where tag accuracy is claimed.

How a certifier is accredited: documented competence and scope, assessor independence/disclosures, evidence review, separation of assessor and decision-maker, review/appeal/complaint, expiry/renewal/scope change/suspension/revocation, record custody and explicit future authority/adoption prerequisites. No invented actual appointments.
Complete applicant/operator/reviewer instructions, explicit access/cost and free personal workflow boundary, private evidence minimization, withdrawal/correction and contestability.
Boundary annex prepared for qualified review of mark use, ownership, certification wording and privacy. No legal assurance, fees/mark license or actual institution is adopted.
proposed_full_deliverable.executable_component: A bounded offline application/evidence checklist verifier for the versioned reference design. Exact approved profile/source hashes, closed typed inputs and required field/check coverage; no user-selected argv, network, badge, signature-based truth, imported approval flags or hidden automatic certification. Report checklist completeness separately from unresolved independent/human/legal decisions.
proposed_full_deliverable.output_meaning: READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW describes a complete reference application/checklist only; INCOMPLETE lists fixed missing requirements; UNAVAILABLE refuses malformed/tampered/unknown source/profile. All certification/accreditation/mark_authorization/independent_accuracy flags stay false. No claim is admitted merely because the checklist is complete.
proposed_full_deliverable.consumer: The documented certifier preparation/review workflow must actually consume this output and let a reader inspect/contest all requirements; an unconsumed report or new wrapper alone is insufficient.

preimplementation_acceptance.required: Execute a fully populated explicitly synthetic application for the adopted reference design, retaining exact source/profile/evidence identities and readable scope-specific outcomes. Inspect that every programme responsibility and future accreditation step is represented, versioned and contestable; no real accreditation is asserted.

An eligible software-interface application can include all14 versioned vectors under both profiles (28 checks), with exact source/digests and supported/failure outcomes. Describe these as selected interface checks only, never full protocol proof, independent accuracy, tag release, or private organization-service certification.

A tag-accuracy application with only those28 interface checks remains incomplete; missing accepted tag gates, independent labels/holdout/error analysis/calibration cannot be fabricated, satisfied by author fixtures or silently marked not-applicable.
Personal PS/protocol results cannot satisfy private organization policy/service permissions, tenant boundaries or custom job claims; explicitly declare absent scope and withhold those claims.

Execute incomplete evidence, source/profile drift, unknown/duplicate/nonfinite/oversized fields, forged authority/accreditation fields and conflicting/unfilled review role cases. No approved/certified/accuracy result may be emitted, and unrelated personal workflows stay unchanged.

Demonstrate separate application, assessor recommendation, contest/correction/appeal and final authority prerequisite. A signed record or multiple keys does not prove real-person independence or an adopted certifier role.

Distinct source/claim review plus versioned actual supported/refused execution and normal protected/public publication of the complete programme design/instructions. Closure recommendation must quote unchanged original criteria and state nonoperating limits. No counter change before complete evidence.
